name: Reserve Bank of India
description: India's central bank, established under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 and commenced operations on 1 April 1935. It is responsible for monetary policy, currency issuance, banking regulation and other central-bank functions.

name: Federal Reserve System
description: The central banking system of the United States, created by the Federal Reserve Act of 1913. The Board of Governors is based in Washington, D.C.

name: Bank of England
description: The United Kingdom's central bank, founded in 1694. Its responsibilities and institutional role have evolved substantially over time.

name: International Monetary Fund
description: An international organisation established at the Bretton Woods Conference in 1944. It works on international monetary cooperation, financial stability, trade, employment and sustainable economic growth.

name: London School of Economics and Political Science
description: Founded in 1895, LSE is a university specialising in social sciences, including economics, finance, public policy and political science.

name: New York Stock Exchange
description: The NYSE traces its origins to the Buttonwood Agreement signed in 1792. The exchange has since evolved through major changes in market structure and technology.

name: Industrial & Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
description: China's largest state-owned commercial bank by assets, established in 1984 and headquartered in Beijing.

name: Agricultural Bank of China
description: One of China's major state-owned commercial banks, with roots in the Agricultural Cooperative Bank established in 1951.

name: China Construction Bank
description: A major Chinese state-owned commercial bank established in 1954 and headquartered in Beijing.

name: Bank of China
description: Founded in 1912, Bank of China is one of China's oldest banks and a major international banking group.

name: JPMorgan Chase
description: A leading US banking group whose historical lineage includes the Bank of the Manhattan Company, founded in 1799; headquartered in New York.

name: Bank of America
description: A major US banking group tracing its origins to the Bank of Italy, founded in San Francisco in 1904; its corporate headquarters are in Charlotte.

name: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG)
description: Japanese financial group formed in 2005 through the creation of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group; headquartered in Tokyo.

name: HSBC
description: Founded in Hong Kong in 1865 to finance trade between Europe and Asia; the group's current global headquarters are in London.

name: BNP Paribas
description: BNP Paribas was formed in 2000 through the merger of Banque Nationale de Paris and Paribas; headquartered in Paris.

name: Crédit Agricole
description: A French mutual banking group whose roots date to the creation of local agricultural credit banks in 1894; Crédit Agricole S.A. is headquartered in Montrouge.

name: Citigroup
description: A global banking group tracing its origins to the City Bank of New York, founded in 1812; headquartered in New York.

name: Postal Savings Bank of China
description: China's nationwide postal savings bank, formally established as a limited liability bank in 2007 and headquartered in Beijing.

name: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group
description: Japanese financial holding company established in 2002 and headquartered in Tokyo.

name: Mizuho Financial Group
description: Japanese financial holding company established in 2000 through the integration of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, Fuji Bank and the Industrial Bank of Japan.

name: Bank of Communications
description: Founded in 1908, Bank of Communications is one of China's oldest banks and is headquartered in Shanghai.

name: Wells Fargo
description: Founded in 1852, Wells Fargo is a major US financial services company headquartered in San Francisco.

name: Banco Santander
description: Founded in Santander, Spain, in 1857; the group's corporate headquarters are now in Boadilla del Monte near Madrid.

name: Société Générale
description: Founded in 1864, Société Générale is a major French banking group headquartered in Paris.

name: Japan Post Bank
description: Established in its current corporate form in 2006 ahead of Japan Post's privatisation and postal-service reorganisation.

name: UBS Group
description: UBS Group AG was established in 2014 as the holding company for UBS; the wider institution traces its roots to 19th-century Swiss banks.

name: State Bank of India (SBI)
description: India's largest public-sector bank, constituted in 1955; its institutional lineage includes the Imperial Bank of India.

name: HDFC Bank
description: Indian private-sector bank incorporated in 1994 and headquartered in Mumbai.

name: ICICI Bank
description: Indian private-sector bank established in 1994 as part of the ICICI group's banking expansion; headquartered in Mumbai.

name: Bank of Baroda
description: Established in 1908 in Baroda, now Vadodara; one of India's major public-sector banks.

name: Punjab National Bank
description: Founded in Lahore in 1894 and now headquartered in New Delhi; one of India's oldest major domestic banks.

name: Canara Bank
description: Founded in 1906 in Mangalore and headquartered in Bengaluru; a major Indian public-sector bank.

name: Axis Bank
description: Established in 1993 as UTI Bank and later renamed Axis Bank; headquartered in Mumbai.

name: Union Bank of India
description: Established in 1919 and inaugurated by Mahatma Gandhi; headquartered in Mumbai.

name: Bank of India
description: Founded in 1906 in Mumbai, where it remains headquartered; a major Indian public-sector bank.

name: Kotak Mahindra Bank
description: Began as Kotak Mahindra Finance in 1985 and received a banking licence in 2003; headquartered in Mumbai.

name: Indian Bank
description: Founded in 1907 and headquartered in Chennai; a major Indian public-sector bank.

name: Central Bank of India
description: Established in 1911 and headquartered in Mumbai; among India's oldest banks founded by Indians.
